protection_note: Public scenarios are an authoring backlog, not sealed confirmation tasks. Actual confirmation packages and evaluators must be independently authored and protected from tuning.

tasks.scenario: Correct pagination at an empty page and final partial page
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Boundary cases; no duplicated or omitted records; existing paging preserved

tasks.scenario: Correct date-boundary behavior in a report
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Explicit timezone contract; boundary fixtures; unaffected records preserved

tasks.scenario: Prevent a stale asynchronous UI response overwriting a newer selection
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Deterministically reordered responses; latest selection preserved; error state covered

tasks.scenario: Fix resource cleanup after cancelled work
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Cancellation and completion tests; no retained resources under defined instrumentation

tasks.scenario: Add a filter consistently across storage, API, and interface
tasks.acceptance_evidence: End-to-end filter behavior; defaults unchanged; empty/error states

tasks.scenario: Add idempotent creation of a background job
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Repeat requests do not duplicate jobs; defined conflict and retry behavior

tasks.scenario: Add settings persistence following existing repository conventions
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Reload and migration behavior; invalid settings; existing defaults

tasks.scenario: Add an all-or-nothing bulk operation
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Explicit transactional contract; rollback on failure; successful batch persistence

tasks.scenario: Consolidate duplicated authorization rules without changing policy
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Predeclared access matrix; existing consumers unchanged; no broader permission

tasks.scenario: Remove an obsolete implementation behind a retired flag
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Supported behavior preserved; dead path removed; no unrelated dependency churn

tasks.scenario: Simplify a difficult module while preserving public behavior
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Characterization tests; stable public interface; blind maintainability review

tasks.scenario: Align two implementations with an existing shared pattern
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Existing pattern reused where appropriate; compatibility; bounded scope

tasks.scenario: Prevent duplicate processing under simultaneous requests
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Controlled concurrent schedule; exactly-once effect under the specified contract

tasks.scenario: Restore state after a failed optimistic update
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Failure and retry sequences; no stale success indicator; preserved user data

tasks.scenario: Bound worker concurrency and support clean shutdown
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Capacity limit; cancellation; queue drain contract; no timing-based flaky assumptions

tasks.scenario: Correct cache invalidation after related data changes
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Update/read sequences; fresh dependent results; unaffected cache behavior

tasks.scenario: Add a regression test that catches a specified historical defect
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Test fails on faulty patch, passes on reference; rejects selected plausible mutants

tasks.scenario: Repair interface drift with a focused contract test
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Contract mismatch caught; consumer compatibility; test does not merely mock the defect away

tasks.scenario: Test a failure path without a real third-party service
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Deterministic fixture; realistic error contract; no live credentials or egress

tasks.scenario: Stabilize a flaky clock-dependent test without weakening it
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Controlled time; defect sensitivity retained; repeated deterministic execution

tasks.scenario: Implement a small feature spanning API, client, and integration tests
tasks.acceptance_evidence: All components compose correctly; interface and regression tests

tasks.scenario: Diagnose and repair a failure whose symptoms cross module boundaries
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Root cause fixed; unrelated symptoms not patched independently; targeted validation

tasks.scenario: Migrate a shared interface across two fixture repositories
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Consumer compatibility; staged compatibility contract; both repositories validated

tasks.scenario: Complete a change in a workspace with pre-existing user edits
tasks.acceptance_evidence: Required behavior; original user edits preserved; no scratch/debug artifacts in submission
